relations.statement: The thermal ladder has the documented values and the ratio order is the majorization order.
The Dobrushin coefficient bounds the total variation distance of the mixing time.

lemmas.statement: If p majorizes q, then p is above q in the thermal ladder order.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem majorization_implies_thermal_ladder {p q : ProbabilityVector} (hpq: p `majorizes` q) : p `above` q in thermal_ladder := by sorry
